name: Tropaeolaceae

children.name: Tropaeolum
children.desc: Tropaeolum, commonly known as nasturtium (; literally "nose-twister" or "nose-tweaker"), is a genus of roughly 80 species of annual and perennial herbaceous flowering plants.
